correctness.rationale: The geometric fixed realization is correctly modeled using full vertex orbits, not fixed vertices. The three-bit rotation has orbit types A=000, B=111, C=weight1, D=weight2 and independently verified max-distance matrix [[0,3,1,2],[3,0,2,1],[1,2,2,3],[2,1,3,2]]. Every pair compatibility agrees for m=0..4. Link of each C_u or D_u is a simplex on the radius-one Hamming ball plus an isolated opposite A/B vertex. Descending-dimensional elementary pair cancellations leave two copies of K_m connected by 2^(m+1) two-edge bridges; one bridge connects copies and remaining 2^(m+1)-1 yield circles. Published K_m wedge-of-c_m S3 gives the stated integral homotopy including m=0,1,2. Finite tests alone do not imply all n, but the orbit-link proof does.
